moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK #1
moments.blurb: The Official Singles Chart for August 13-19 sees Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remain at number one, with new entries from Madonna & Kylie Minogue and Ella Langley making waves.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still reigning supreme! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold tight at UK #1 with 'Rein Me In' this week. What's your favourite track in the Top 40?

angles.name: New Entries Buzz
angles.copy: Madonna & Kylie Minogue's 'Love Sensation' is a brand new entry in the UK Top 40! Plus, Ella Langley is climbing fast. What are you streaming?

moments.title: Classic drama 'Vanity Fair' arrives on BritBox

angles.name: Becky Sharp
angles.copy: Olivia Cooke as Becky Sharp? Yes please! 'Vanity Fair' arrives on BritBox tomorrow for your next dose of high-society drama.
